title: 第三章 魔门是什么门第四章 陛下相邀
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
“这……怎么会这样？”
“渊海之极，竟然是这样的一方天地！”
“亏了宗主大人赐下的冲云舟，我们才能度过那无尽瘴气……”
“瞧，好……好大！”
……
不单单是大夏国民在为这破空而来的浮空船舟而感到惊叹。
那奇异小舟之上，数名身着统一青色道袍的青年男女，此刻也睁大了双眼，望向下方那片蔚蓝海洋，以及远方那片从未踏足的土地，接连发出惊叹。
这片未知之地的大小，已经赶得上仙盟一洲之地了。
和风拂面，一位女子凭栏俯瞰，眼眸清亮，忽然指向下方，不住喊道：“师兄，你瞧你瞧，此地也有人，下面还有一艘大船！”
神武号发出阵阵轰鸣声声，这凝聚当世大夏科技与国力巅峰的庞然巨物，正喷着白色蒸汽，破浪前行，声势浩荡，威仪凛凛。
虽然不会飞，却是比之他们的小船要威风霸气太多了。
这是他们从未见过的巨型法器，没感应到半分灵力，未刻有法阵，那般小的风帆，究竟如何推动如此巨物？莫非用了什么罕见宝材？
姑娘长得清丽动人，格外引人注目。
被她唤作师兄的，是一面容清秀的男子，在一众青衣弟子之中独穿白衣，站在木船桅杆之下，队伍的最前方。
此刻他却无心回应师妹的呼唤，只凝神专注于眼前。一手托着青铜罗盘，另一手并指掐诀，唇间低诵密咒。
罗盘在无形之力催动下缓缓转动，泛起幽微光芒，诸多难以辨识的符文自盘中浮现流转。
“这……这……”
随着术法推进，他身体愈发震颤，眼珠瞪得老大，张大了嘴，竟说不出一句完整的话来。
手中的罗盘越转越快，越转越快，光亮也越发闪耀，从一开始的青色幽光竟逐渐发红发热，无形符文也如爆炸般涌流。
他指尖轻颤，额前渗出汗珠。

“嗒。”
“嗒。”
汗珠坠下，他浑身一震，似乎是再也坚持不住，直接闷哼了声：“额……”
仰面向后摔倒，手中的罗盘也疯狂运转，完全失控。
“砰！”
竟然砰的一声，直接爆裂开来。
“师兄！”
“师兄！”
突遭变故，众人从对新天地的震撼中猛然惊醒，急忙上前搀扶。
“呵呵……”
“哈哈哈哈！”
“呵呵哈哈哈哈哈！”
陆俊峰满头大汗，被几个师弟搀扶住，好悬没有一屁股坐到地上。如此狼狈，然而他却浑然不觉，反倒咧开嘴，放肆笑出声来。
“师兄，您怎么了？”
“您没事吧？”
陆俊峰一把推开身旁师弟，踉跄扑到船边，望向远方那片浩瀚大陆，伸手向前虚抓，眼神迷离如醉，口中呢喃着断续的句子：“好多……实在太多了……”
“师兄，你到底怎么了？”
“灵气……如此浓郁的灵气！还有灵矿……这、这是何等钟灵毓秀之地，简直是洞天福地！太华之幸，仙盟之幸，此乃仙盟之幸啊！”
此言一出，其他人也是猛地一震。
什么？！”

“当真如此？！”
“难道……是因为此地灵气太过充沛，连师兄的‘灵秀盘’都承受不住，才会损毁？”
“难怪……我一到此地，便觉气息通畅，郁结尽消。原来如此，原来此地竟是这般宝地！”
“哈哈哈哈！有此宝地，我太华宗可以无忧矣！”
如此浩瀚的灵气，这该是多少财富、多少资源啊！
content_en:
"How...how could this happen?"
"At the end of the abyss, there is such a world!"
"Thanks to the Chongyun Boat given by the sect leader, we were able to survive the endless miasma..."
"Look, it's so... so big!"
…
Not only the people of Daxia were amazed by this floating boat that broke through the sky.
On the strange boat, several young men and women wearing uniform blue robes also opened their eyes wide at this moment, looking at the blue ocean below and the land in the distance that they had never set foot on before, and they exclaimed one after another in amazement.
The size of this unknown land is already comparable to that of the Immortal Alliance.
The breeze was blowing, and a woman leaned on the railing and looked down. Her eyes were clear, and she suddenly pointed downwards and kept shouting: "Brother, look, look, there are people here, and there is a big ship below!"
The Shenwu made roaring sounds. This behemoth, which embodies the pinnacle of Daxia's technology and national power at that time, was blowing white steam and moving forward through the waves with great momentum and majesty.
Although it can't fly, it is much more majestic and domineering than their boats.
This is a giant magic weapon that they have never seen before. It does not sense any spiritual power and has no magic circle engraved on it. How can such a small sail propel such a huge thing? Could it be that some rare treasure material was used?
The girl is beautiful and eye-catching.
The man she called her senior brother was a man with a handsome face. Among the disciples in green, he was alone in white and stood at the front of the team under the mast of the wooden ship.
At this moment, he had no intention of responding to his junior sister's call, he only focused on what was in front of him. Holding a bronze compass in one hand, making a hand gesture with the other hand, he recited a secret mantra between his lips.
The compass rotates slowly under the influence of invisible force, glowing faintly, and many unidentifiable runes emerge from the disk.
"This...this..."
As the technique progressed, his body became more and more trembling, his eyes widened, and his mouth opened wide, unable to utter a complete sentence.
The compass in his hand turned faster and faster, and the light shone brighter and brighter. The cyan light from the beginning gradually turned red and hot, and invisible runes also flowed out like an explosion.
His fingertips trembled slightly, and beads of sweat formed on his forehead.
"Ta."
"Ta."
Beads of sweat fell, and he was shaken all over. It seemed that he couldn't hold on any longer, and he groaned: "Uh..."
He fell backwards and the compass in his hand was spinning wildly, completely out of control.
"Bang!"
It actually exploded with a bang.
"Brother!"
"Brother!"
Suddenly, everyone suddenly woke up from the shock of the new world and hurriedly stepped forward to help.
"Haha..."
"Hahahaha!"
"Hahahahahaha!"
Lu Junfeng was sweating profusely, and was supported by several junior brothers, barely able to sit down on the ground. He was so embarrassed, but he didn't realize it. Instead, he grinned and laughed wildly.
"Brother, what's wrong with you?"
"Are you okay?"
Lu Junfeng pushed the junior brother beside him away, staggered to the side of the boat, looked at the vast continent in the distance, stretched out his hand to grasp, his eyes were blurred and intoxicated, and he murmured intermittent sentences: "There are so many...it's too much..."
"Brother, what's wrong with you?"
"Aura...such a rich aura! There are also spiritual mines...this, this is such a beautiful place, it is simply a blessed land! Taihua's luck, the Immortal Alliance's luck, this is the Immortal Alliance's luck!"
As soon as these words came out, others were shocked.
What? ! "
"Really? ! "
"Could it be... that the spiritual energy in this place was so abundant that even senior brother's 'Lingxiu Pan' couldn't bear it, so it was damaged? "
"No wonder...as soon as I arrived here, my breath became clear and all my depression disappeared. So it turns out that this place is such a treasure! "
"Ha ha ha ha! With this treasure land, our Taihua Sect can have no worries! "
Such vast spiritual energy, how much wealth and resources this must be!
